title: 日本ダービーにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Japanese Derby is the second race of the Classic Triple Crown. Rumor has it that the other racers there are intimidated by Narita Brian…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I feel a little uneasy about such unsavory rumors, but Narita Brian brushes them off as nothing more than white noise.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Each one of the racers in her year is serious about victory. The thought pleases Narita Brian, setting her fighting spirit alight.
